verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own GitHub docs say developers can define custom schemas to extract structured JSON. Its docs also describe CSS-, XPath- and LLM-based structured extraction, so the product directly delivers JSON output from scraped pages. missing for 10: a documented example of the JSON result shape or output field, and independent hands-on corroboration of JSON extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON

citations.quote: Schema Definition: Define custom schemas for extracting structured JSON from repetitive patterns.
Structured Extraction: Parse repeated patterns with CSS, XPath, or LLM-based extraction.
LLM-Driven Extraction: Supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary) for structured data extraction.
